title: 005 惨死的王姬下006 路易十六战术上
content_zh:
【是否合成“一件血衣”？】
【确定合成】
【物品“一件血衣”的说明：这是一件造价昂贵的女式丝绸华服，各处绣工精致，非寻常富贵人家能拥有，而今却与主人一道被钝器暴力砍断，沦为鲜血淤泥的载体。】
张泱闲着无聊将血衣碎片合成一件。
盯着物品说明看了好一会儿。
尺有所长，寸有所短。
她最不擅长的就是这些需要抽丝剥茧的东西，一看到就觉得脑子疼，张泱选择了场外求助：“叔德，你知道我为什么会被人用钝器砍断手脚吊死房梁，脑袋又搬家吗？”
什么人这么恨“自己”？
砍断手臂不够，还要将手臂砍成三截？
砍死人还不够，还要将人吊上房梁？
一件血衣硬生生变成了三十多片。
不远处的沈知脊背不自然僵硬一瞬，连带头顶名字也飞速切换颜色。黑暗中，她听到他平静声音下的隐忍：“殿下是要报仇？”
张泱道：“总该知道自己怎么死的，为什么会死，才好慎重判断下一步怎么走。”
考虑到游戏中玩家经手过的任务，张泱还真不敢拍着胸脯说参与剧情的玩家是全然无辜的。游戏任务之中，玩家被人利用误杀、错杀、冤杀酿造出惨剧也不是一次两次。
鬼晓得家园支线中的玩家干过啥事儿。
沈知那边沉默了会儿。
“我也不知，不过也能猜出一些。”
“是叛军做的？”
记得沈知此前提过叛军。
沈知摇头道：“未必是叛军。”

张泱听出他这话另有深意。
“你有怀疑目标？”
沈知朝张泱这边看过来，电光恰好照在他半张脸上，映出了那只眼睛蕴藏的复杂。
“也有可能是背叛。”
张泱仔细咀嚼这句话背后的深意。
沈知继续道：“虽说殿下失了记忆，往日种种你也没有印象，但有些事情你还是该知道的，殿下平日的名声极为不堪，待下暴虐。恰逢逃难之时，难保无人生出歹念。”
还是王孙贵胄的时候，自然能作威作福。
可虎落平阳，哪有人愿意继续忍着？
至少在沈知看来，死有余辜。
只可惜，人没有死成。
沈知心中暗暗叹气。
啧，怎么这样都还没死成？
张泱觉察出一点不对劲。
这十多年来，她观察的玩家样本没有一万也有一千了，他们平日确实喜爱各种暴力械斗，一三五基地内部械斗，二四基地外部械斗，六日两天还浩浩荡荡去围攻异兽丧尸被感染的怪异生物，打赢了就嗷嗷去扒战败者的尸体，在游戏主线任务中也经常犯浑。
可，这都跟名声不堪、待下暴虐无关。
事实上，玩家的名声极好。
在各个势力帮派基地都是座上宾。
走到哪里都是呼朋引伴。
她怀疑家园支线可能是游戏策划设计的独立故事线，这在以往版本更新也有出现。
若是独立故事线，一切也能说得通。
content_en:
[Is it to be synthesized into "a bloody suit"? 】
【Confirm synthesis】
[Explanation of the item "A Bloody Clothes": This is an expensive silk dress for women, with exquisite embroidery work everywhere. It is an unusual possession for a wealthy family. However, it was violently chopped off with a blunt instrument along with its owner and turned into a carrier of blood sludge. 】
Zhang Yang was bored and combined the fragments of blood clothes into one piece.
I stared at the item description for a long time.
A ruler is longer and an inch is shorter.
What she is worst at is these things that need to be peeled off, and her head hurts when she sees them. Zhang Yang chooses to ask for help outside the venue: "Shude, do you know why my hands and feet were cut off with blunt instruments and hung from the rafters, and my head was moved?"
Who hates "themselves" so much?
Cutting off the arm is not enough, but also cutting the arm into three pieces?
It's not enough to hack people to death, but also to hang them from the rafters?
A piece of bloody clothing suddenly turned into more than thirty pieces.
Not far away, Shen Zhi's back stiffened unnaturally for a moment, and the name above his head also changed colors rapidly. In the darkness, she heard the forbearance in his calm voice: "Your Highness, you want revenge?"
Zhang Yang said: "You should know how and why you died, so that you can carefully decide what to do next."
Considering the tasks that players have handled in the game, Zhang Yang really doesn't dare to pat his chest and say that the players involved in the plot are completely innocent. In the game missions, it is not once or twice that players are taken advantage of to accidentally kill, wrongly kill, or unjustly kill and cause tragedies.
Who knows what the players in the Home branch have done.
Shen Zhi was silent for a while.
"I don't know either, but I can make some guesses."
"Did the rebels do it?"
I remember Shen Zhi mentioned the rebels before.
Shen Zhi shook his head and said, "They may not be rebels."
Zhang Yang could tell that there was a deeper meaning in his words.
"Do you suspect the target?"
Shen Zhi looked towards Zhang Yang, and the electric light happened to shine on half of his face, reflecting the complexity contained in that eye.
"It could also be betrayal."
Zhang Yang carefully chewed on the meaning behind this sentence.
Shen Zhi continued: "Although His Highness has lost his memory and you have no memory of the past, there are still some things you should know. His Highness usually has a very bad reputation and is brutally treated by others. When he is fleeing, there is no guarantee that no one will have evil thoughts."
When he was still a king, grandson, nobleman, he could naturally dominate and bring blessings.
But when the tiger falls, how can anyone be willing to endure it?
At least in Shen Zhi's view, death was more than justified.
It's a pity that people don't die.
Shen Zhi sighed secretly in his heart.
Gee, why are you still not dead?
Zhang Yang noticed something was wrong.
Over the past ten years, she has observed between 10,000 and 1,000 player samples. They really like all kinds of violent fighting on weekdays, including fighting inside the 135 base and outside the 24th base. On the 6th and 6th, they would besiege strange zombies and infected strange creatures. After winning, they would pick up the corpses of the defeated, and they often made mistakes in the main tasks of the game.
However, this has nothing to do with the bad reputation and cruel treatment.
In fact, players have an excellent reputation.
They are all guests at the bases of various factions and gangs.
Wherever I go, I make friends.
She suspected that the home branch might be an independent story line designed by the game planner, which has also appeared in previous version updates.
If it were an independent story line, everything would make sense.
